# Remote Control Agent v0.1.45

## Changes
- Enable owner-local deliberate Stop and signed Resume for permanent Linux/WSL2 and Windows devices, using the existing identity and managed service.
- Keep the private owner-OFF marker across service restart, with same-key signed cloud intent and epoch protection; no remote MCP-initiated Resume.
- Preserve operation receipts and Unknown outcomes; no automatic re-pairing.
- Carry candidate macOS ARM64 LaunchAgent Stop/Resume source; macOS personal-host and immutable native public Release acceptance remain separately gated.
